info.title: API.SH: Amazon
info.description: The Amazon API from API.SH: public Amazon data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Amazon's Today's Deals, 30 per page: deal price, typical/list price, discount, deal badge and type (lightning or not), deal id and state, department and brand ids, variations. Page 1 also lists the refinements (departments, brands, rating, price and discount ranges) whose values `department` and `brand` take. `department`, `brand`, `coupons` and `prime_exclusive` are applied by Amazon; `min_discount`, `min_price`, `max_price` and `lightning` are applied to each page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amazon-deals

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every seller's offer for a product, as in Amazon's Other sellers panel: the buy-box offer (`buy_box: true`, page 1 only, when the product has one), then 10 offers per page with condition, price, shipping, delivery dates, ships-from, sold-by, the seller's id, rating, ratings count and positive feedback, Prime, max quantity and the offer listing id. Filters by condition, Prime and free delivery are applied by Amazon. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amazon-offers

get.summary: Top reviews of an Amazon product
get.description:
The reviews a product page shows to visitors who are not signed in: the review cards (about 8-13: the marketplace's top reviews, then top reviews from other countries), the rating histogram, `summary` (Amazon's AI summary of the reviews), `aspects` (what customers mention, with sentiment, mention, positive and negative counts, a summary and quotes) and `review_snippets` (quoted review excerpts, each with its review id). Amazon shows the full review list only to signed-in users, and since 27 Oct 2026 amazon.com shows even its review cards only to signed-in users: for amazon.com (`sign_in_required: true`) `reviews` holds the top reviews another marketplace (amazon.ca, then amazon.co.uk, amazon.com.au) shows for the same ASIN, which include reviews written in the United States; `reviews_from` names that marketplace and each review has its `country` and `marketplace`. When no other marketplace sells the product, `reviews` is empty and `review_snippets` holds the excerpts. No paging: these are all the reviews shown without a sign-in.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amazon-reviews

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Amazon marketplace: com (default), co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, com.mx, com.br, com.au, in, co.jp, nl, se, pl, com.be, com.tr, ae, sa, sg, eg, ie. Taken from the product URL when it has one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the review cards: top (default, the order Amazon shows) or recent (newest first, by `date_iso`). Both return the same cards: without a sign-in Amazon shows only its top reviews.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
